questions.skill: Solve real-world problems with the volumes of cylinders, cones, and spheres
questions.prompt: A straight-sided cylindrical container has an inside radius of 5 cm and holds water. It is tall enough that no water spills. A ball with a radius of 3 cm is dropped in and sinks completely under the water. How many centimeters does the water level rise?
questions.prompt_markup:
A straight-sided cylindrical container has an inside radius of 5 cm and holds water. It is tall enough that no water spills. A ball with a radius of 3 cm is dropped in and sinks completely under the water.
How many centimeters does the water level rise?
questions.grading_note: The rise is the ball's volume, 36π, divided by the base area, 25π.
